_comment: Corpus settings for run_corpus.py (mcx7). Setups are found by alamo_mod_check --list-mods; this file only names
display names, the map / campaign picks of the reference set (docs/MODS.md 10.3 and 10.4) and accepted blockers.
An entry applies to every setup whose resolved stack contains that mod (a parent's settings reach its submods);
the setup's own entry wins. Keys: name, reference, space_map, land_map, campaign, skirmish_args (extra
alamo_headless arguments of the skirmish runs), galactic_args, smoke_env ({VAR: value} for the smokes), accept
([{blocker: regex, why, ref}]: an explained, retail-equivalent or by-design blocker that does not lower the grade).

accept.why: the sandbox starts every player at AI_Player_Control None; the GC master script switches the AI on only after the human answers its HISTORICAL_GC_CHOICE popup, which a headless AI-only run never does

the mod's own Data/Scripts/Library/PGCommands.lua shadows FoC's and defines only Try_Weapon_Switch_Ground, while its BusyTacticalFreeStore.lua and PGEvents.lua still call Try_Weapon_Switch: retail resolves require('pgcommands') to the same mod file and raises the same nil-call error
